units.source_text: 若说理想的话，不通过村落迂回逃出是最好不过，

en.t: Ideally, the best thing would be to escape by going around the village,

units.source_text: 但西侧有相当危险的海峡阻挡，不算高，

en.t: but on the west side a fairly dangerous channel blocked the way; it was not especially high,

units.source_text: 但一直受旧时代波涛的侵蚀，

en.t: yet it had long been eroded by the waves of an earlier age,
forming what was called the Screen Rock.

units.source_text: 村落的那帮家伙为了去拾柴火设有立脚点，

en.t: The villagers had made footholds there so they could go gather firewood,

units.source_text: 但被草丛挡住了，很难简单分辨，

en.t: but they were hidden by the grass and were hard to make out at a glance,

units.source_text: 他又不便多问，怕引起女人的怀疑反而会坏事。

en.t: and he could not very well ask too many questions, afraid that arousing the woman's suspicion would only spoil things.

units.source_text: 反过来，东面是又窄又深的入海口，

en.t: On the other hand, to the east lay a narrow, deep inlet,

units.source_text: 无人的沙丘上上下下有十多公里，

en.t: and the deserted dunes rose and fell for more than ten kilometers,

units.source_text: 但最后，转上一圈还得回到村子的出口那一带。

en.t: but in the end, after making the circuit, one still had to come back near the village exit.

units.source_text: 总之，这个村落是个“沙袋子”，

en.t: In short, this village was a kind of sandbag,

units.source_text: 屏风岩和入海口扎紧了袋口。

en.t: with the Screen Rock and the inlet cinching its mouth shut.

units.source_text: 与其磨磨蹭蹭地浪费时间，

en.t: Rather than dawdle and waste time,

units.source_text: 让那些家伙们放松警惕，

en.t: letting those fellows lower their guard,

units.source_text: 倒不如下狠心采取中央突破的作战方式，

en.t: it would be better to steel himself and adopt a strategy of breaking straight through the center,
which would actually give him a higher chance of safety.
